title: annotations/1: the CSV of export.annotations@1, every annotation of every feature
description: A CSV (text/csv, no header comment) with one row per feature x method x candidate rank, sorted by feature id, then method (standard, library, in silico, suspect, formula), then rank. It writes what the upstream steps found, with their levels and evidence; it adds no identity and raises no level. Rows that cannot be joined to a feature of the table have an empty feature_id and the query id in source_file (name:query). Native flow run and the browser (flowtab .wasm) write the same bytes. The separator is a comma, or a semicolon with the parameter separator; a cell with the separator, a quote or a line break is quoted.

x-columns.name: feature_id
x-columns.description: 1-based row of the alignment table; empty when the query id could not be joined

x-columns.name: rt_min
x-columns.description: RT of the feature in minutes, 4 decimals

x-columns.name: level
x-columns.description: the annot/1 decision of the feature, repeated on every row of the feature; empty without annot

x-columns.name: level_why
x-columns.description: the annot/1 basis of that decision

x-columns.name: rank
x-columns.description: 1 = best by the score of the method, within the feature; at most top_per_method

x-columns.name: score
x-columns.description: the own score of the method, 6 decimals; scores of different methods are never compared, score_name says which it is

x-columns.name: score_name
x-columns.description: spectral_entropy, cosine, modified_cosine (library), insilico, fragments (suspect: listed fragments found), formula_ms1, formula_ms2; standard: the score of the gate of the standard

x-columns.name: delta_ppm
x-columns.description: mass error of the candidate in ppm, 3 decimals

x-columns.name: delta_rt_min
x-columns.description: RT difference in minutes, 3 decimals (library with an RT, suspect with a listed RT, standard)

x-columns.name: matched_fragments
x-columns.description: shared peaks (library, in silico), listed fragments found (suspect), peaks explained (formula.ms2)

x-columns.name: listed_in
x-columns.description: ids of the lists of screen/1 that name the structure, joined by |; empty when none

x-columns.name: source_file
x-columns.description: name of the upstream file the row came from

x-parameters.min_level: empty = all; else only features whose annot level is at or above it (order 1, 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b, 4, 5, 0)
